name: Hardcoded
storyline: In Hardcoded, the player controls a droid, who goes by "Hard Coded" or HC for short, because her factory-made male deadname is "hardcoded" into her and she is not able to change it. HC ran away from her owners and joins the local trans community in Pira City at the beginning of the game. GelCorp, a massive corporation, is infecting everyone with pollution that makes everyone horny, and HC and her friends resolve to solve the mystery.
summary:
Harcoded is a lesbian cyberpunk erotic dating sim about trans girls, droids, and slime monsters.

Hardcoded is an open-world dating-sim, set in the lawless reaches of a cyberpunk dystopia, in which players take on the role of a thinking/learning droid who has recently escaped her owners and is on the run. Before players can fully settle into their new life, it becomes obvious that Pira City is a place of dark and dangerous secrets. Fortunately, players can befriend a cast of very horny characters who seek aid in pursuing a shadowrun-style investigation.

Players can spend their downtime trying to establish themselves by earning money, decorating their apartment, buying clothes, collecting sci-fi dildos, or working on turning friendships into romances.
